quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Recognize that each moment with your child is precious; invest in meaningful interactions rather than falling into mindless routines.
    • Teach by example—demonstrate how deliberate, thoughtful actions build trust and respect, nurturing a purposeful life for them.
  • Leadership:
    • Let every decision reflect intent and clarity; steer your team with actions that have well-defined, positive outcomes.
    • Encourage a culture where each task contributes to a larger mission, ensuring that collective efforts are never wasted.
  • Product Management:
    • Prioritize features and developments that deliver clear value to users, cutting away any practices that don’t move the project forward.
    • Embrace iterative progress with purpose—each release should be evidence of intentional design and strategic direction.
